name: Expedia One Key

apr.notes: 18.49%, 23.49%, or 28.49% based on your creditworthiness. This APR will vary with the market based on the U.S. Prime Rate. Balance Transfer APR: 18.49%, 23.49%, or 28.49%. Cash Advance APR: 28.49%. Minimum interest charge $1.00. Balance transfer fee: up to 5% with a minimum of $5. Cash advance fee: either $10 or 5% of the amount, whichever is greater. Late payment fee up to $40. No penalty APR. Information correct as of December 2025.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee for purchases converted to U.S. dollars. Foreign Currency Conversion/Foreign Transaction: None.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated. Three APR tiers (18.49%, 23.49%, 28.49%) based on creditworthiness. May not be eligible if opened a One Key, One Key+, or Hotels.com Card within the last 48 months.

categories.label: Gas stations, grocery stores, and dining

rewards.redemption_notes: OneKeyCash is not redeemable for cash and can only be used on Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. The 3% rate on Expedia/Hotels.com/Vrbo is 1.5% base plus 1.5% bonus. Must be logged into the primary cardholder's One Key member account. 3% on gas/grocery/dining is also 1.5% base plus 1.5% bonus.

signup_bonus.description: Earn $250 in OneKeyCash after you spend $1,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening. OneKeyCash earned through the introductory offer will post to your account within 1-2 billing periods after it is earned.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fee
benefits.description: Use your card when you travel and pay no foreign transaction fees for purchases converted to U.S. dollars.

benefits.title: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $1,000 of cell phone protection against damage, theft, or unintended separation. Subject to a $25 deductible. Allowable maximum of two paid claims per 12-month period. Each approved claim has a benefit limit of $1,000. Does not cover cell phones that are lost.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Protection
benefits.description: Receive reimbursement for the nonrefundable cost of your common carrier fare if your trip is canceled or interrupted for a covered reason. Coverage is secondary.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Pay for rental transactions with your eligible credit card and receive reimbursement of up to $50,000 if covered damage to or theft of your eligible rental vehicle occurs. Coverage is primary (except for New York Residents).

benefits.title: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Get Travel Accident Insurance protection of up to $1,000,000 when you purchase your airline or other common carrier tickets with your eligible credit card.

benefits.title: Automatic One Key Silver Status
benefits.description: Automatic One Key Silver membership with Silver Member Prices: savings of 15% or more on over 10,000 hotels worldwide. Unlock Gold when you spend $15,000 per calendar year.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic One Key Silver status (15%+ savings on 10,000+ hotels). Gold status unlocked at $15,000 annual spend.
other: Cellular Telephone Protection up to $1,000 ($25 deductible)
Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver up to $50,000

notes: Issued by Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. World Elite Mastercard (confirmed from Guide to Benefits link text). $0 annual fee. APR: 18.49%, 23.49%, or 28.49% variable. Credit score band changed from 'good_to_excellent' to 'unknown' — not explicitly stated on official pages.
